{{Quote|We absolutely made a call -- what was it, Gorrga, ten seconds? Ten seconds after we shoved the fighter over the side of the building.|Koblus Sornell|<ref name="Interference">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/interference20090929.html|text="Interference"|int=Interference|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>}}
'''Gorrga''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] at the time of the [[Taris Siege|occupation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] by the Mandalorians. In [[3963 BBY]], they left a [[Davaab-type starfighter|''Davaab''-type starfighter]] on top of the [[Highport Banking Tower]] but the [[Starship/Legends|craft]] was soon pushed over the side of the building by [[Koblus Sornell]] to make way for a receiver platform.
